## Project Type
Next.js 14 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion

## Description
Professional construction company portfolio website for WW Construction with modern animations.

## Features Implemented
- Animated navbar with scroll effect
- Hero section with gradient background and floating elements
- Services section with icon animations
- Projects portfolio with category filter
- About section with company stats
- Contact form with info cards
- Footer with social media links
- Full responsive design
- Smooth scroll animations using Framer Motion

## Development Server
Running on http://localhost:3001
